_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for Claude model roster + task-tier -> model mapping used when dispatching subagents. agent-delegation.md's model table points here.
_meta.authoritative_availability_source: The Claude Desktop model selector (bottom-right of the app) is the ground truth for which models are AVAILABLE right now. The Agent/Workflow tool `model` enum lists dispatchable ALIASES but does NOT reflect live availability (e.g. fable is a valid alias yet currently unavailable). When reconciling, trust the desktop selector for availability.
